name: EvalRunCaseSource
description: EvalRunCaseSource is where an eval run's cases come from.

fields.name: Plugin
fields.description:
A plugin whose evals/ folder holds the cases: one the agent attaches,
 or the compared plugin.

fields.name: Eval
fields.description:
An Eval of the agent's organization whose cases run on the agent: its
 current version, or the tag or digest the reference's version names.
 The caller must be able to view it.
